cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a hangar maintenance bay — standing; a quiet neon-lit self-service laundromat at night with round unlettered machine doors and a row of orange plastic seats — she taps a rhythm softly on a laundry basket while waiting for the spin cycle; the stone stairway up to an old city gate tower — tears a finished page out of a notebook; an amusement-park parade street lined with spectators — holds her keepsake at chest height; a modern harbour passenger-ferry bow under an overcast sky — she pauses during a ferry crossing; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — holds a microphone close to her lips; a hydroponic garden dome aboard a starship — sweeps the stones off a go board with black and white stones into their bowls; a sunny concrete skate park of smooth bowls and ramps — holds a smartphone at chest height; a lakeside of flat rocks and still water — swimming breaststroke; her tower bedchamber in a stone castle — works a hairbrush through a tangled lock of hair; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing; a Guan Yu temple — carries her keepsake low at her side; a hotel suite with a city view and an open suitcase — sitting on the ground
